title: Canberra Bomber Crash, Tiverton
memorial_details: Polished pink granite stone of remembrance with gilded inscription in capital lettering. There is nearby an associated information board about the crash.
inscription: IN MEMORY OF/ (Names)/ WHO LOST THEIR LIVES WHEN THE AIRCRAFT/ THEY WERE FLYING CRASHED HERE AT/ 18:50 HOURS 21ST NOVEMBER 1961/ "WE WILL REMEMBER THEM"
crash_date_review: Auto-corrected to 1961-11-21 but reverted — year 1961 outside WW2 range
